kraven.name: Kraven's Last Hunt
kraven.rules_text:
Mill five cards. When you do, this Saga deals damage equal to the greatest power among creature cards in your graveyard to target creature.
Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

primeval.name: Primeval Bounty
primeval.rules_text:
Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 3 life.
